text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to live up to the expectations of everyone who supports me
and my Trainer who trained me with a big "BAM!",
but...
choice_data_list: What matters is that you keep on challenging yourself.
I want you to show me what you've got in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even though I can never make up my mind,
everyone still cheers me on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Then I won't give up—I'll just push forward!
All right, next time I'll definitely take 1st place!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! Trainer, you're already
anticipating what I'll do next, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Then I have to keep moving forward too!
Next time, I'll definitely win and live up to everyone's expectations!"
